{{Top|leg}}
An '''Holographic tactical display''' was a [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads up display]] designed for [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Description==
Mounted between the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] and the flight controls as to overlay the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] vision as he flies, the [[holograph]]ic tactical display was capable of vastly improving a pilots ability to maneuver a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which was essential when navigating an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] or in close combat.<ref name="Shadow">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> A more combat based tactical display was used in the ''[[Bes'uliik]]'', with the display allowing for enhanced targeting, tracking, and systems access and readout with a glance of the eye.<ref name="Sac">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Shadow Games]]''
*''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''
